svg.title: Kafka offline consumer replay — how a service catches up on missed messages after going offline
svg.desc: Timeline showing three scenarios: consumer always online gets messages live, consumer goes offline and comes back auto-replays missed messages from last committed offset, brand new service can replay from the very beginning of the topic.

g.text: Kafka topic — order.placed (stored on disk · kept 7 days)
messages never deleted after read — only after retention period

svg.text: gets all 7 messages live as they arrive
Scenario 2 — goes offline, auto-replays on restart (like WhatsApp)
auto-replays missed offsets 3, 4, 5 on reconnect — then continues live
zero extra code — Kafka tracks last committed offset per groupId
Scenario 3 — brand new service, replay from the beginning
set fromBeginning: true → replays every message ever published
useful for audits, new microservices joining a running system, debugging
how Kafka knows where to resume
